HRITHWIK C S  THIS CRIMINAL REVISION PETITION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 08.10.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl.Rev.Pet. No.1091 of 2023  3  2025:KER:74363  P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN, J  --------------------------------

 Dated this the 08th day of October, 2025  ORDER
This Criminal Revision Petition is filed against the order dated 06.05.2022 in C.M.P. No.1995/2022 in C.C. No.904/2015 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ponnani.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ponnani
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It is an order passed by the learned Magistrate under Section 319 Cr.P.C.
2.
Annexure - 2 charge sheet was filed against one Shyju Thomas, Son of Thomas alleging offence punishable under Section 420 IPC.
The prosecution case is that the accused cheated the defacto complainant.
It is alleged that the accused offered to arrange a job visa for the son of the defacto complainant if the defacto complainant would pay an amount of Rs.4,50,000/- to the accused.
The amount 2025:KER:74363 was paid.
However, the accused failed to arrange the job visa.

Hence it is alleged that the original accused committed the offence under Section 420 IPC.
3.
The evidence in the above case was started.
The prosecution examined the defacto complainant as PW1.
In his testimony he said that the mother of the accused is also involved in the case.
Thereafter the Assistant Public Prosecutor filed an application under Section 319 Cr.P.C.

Based on the same,
the learned Magistrate passed the impugned order.

The finding of the learned Magistrate in the impugned order after narrating the above facts is extracted hereunder:
Annie Thomas vs State Of Kerala on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123835616/
2

entities.text: Annie Thomas vs State Of Kerala
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "The APP then filed this application under section 319 of the Code.
PW1's testimony shows that the accused's mother was with him every step of the way.
Therefore, the accused's mother, too, appears to be guilty of the offence punishable under section 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
Therefore, she shall be proceeded against under section 319 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Issue summons to the accused's mother (Aanees, W/O.Thomas, Chakkalakkal House, 2025:KER:74363 Puliyanam Post, Aluva Taluk, Ernakulam District)."

4. I am of the considered opinion that this is not the manner in which an accused is to be implicated invoking the powers under Section 319 Cr.P.C. When a person is going to be arraigned as an accused, sufficient evidence is necessary.
The learned Magistrate should prima facie conclude by a speaking order that additional accused is also involved in the case.
Simply because one of the witness deposed about an accused, unless the learned Magistrate applied its mind and decided that there is prima facie evidence, Section 319 Cr.P.C. cannot be invoked.
I am of the considered opinion that the issue is to be reconsidered by the learned Magistrate.

Therefore, this Criminal Revision Petition is allowed in the following manner:
1.
The order dated 06.05.2022 in C.M.P. No.1995/2022 in C.C. No.904/2015 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ponnani is set aside.

entities.label: COURT

The Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Ponnani is directed to reconsider C.M.P. No.1995/2022 in C.C. No.904/2015, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and the prosecutor concerned, as expeditiously as possible.
